title.zh: 给扫描台装上频率刻度

t.zh: 扫描器已经能处理局部变化，但规则条纹可能遍布整幅图，靠局部平滑还会损失有用细节。这章要造频率分析仪，先构造能与条纹比较的波形。负值表示围绕零的变化，计算会完整保留。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The scanner handles local changes, but periodic stripes span the image and local smoothing may remove useful detail. Build a frequency analyser, beginning with waves to compare against stripes. Negative readings represent variation around zero and remain intact in computations. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 频率控制重复次数，相位控制排列关系。数值表保留灰度显示无法呈现的读数。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Frequency controls repetitions; phase controls alignment. Numeric tables retain readings hidden by grayscale clipping. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 整行长度表示 1 周，先只产生一个周期。按照给定相位改变起点，不改变周期数；保留波形的正负读数。余弦元件自动计算角度对应的读数。
brief.en: The row length represents one turn. Produce one cycle while changing its starting phase, without changing cycle count. Retain signed values; cosine computes the readings automatically.

naiveWhy.zh: 相位改变同一周期的起点。完全忽略相位会让不同起点得到同一张表；增加整整一周则应回到原来的读数。
naiveWhy.en: Phase changes where a cycle starts. Ignoring it makes different starting phases identical; adding one complete turn should restore the original readings.

t.zh: 频率分析先需要一把可重复的刻度。余弦元件以“周”为角度单位，1 周回到同一读数，四分之一周与半周落在不同位置；数值由元件计算。先只改变起点，观察波形在周期内怎样排列。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Frequency analysis needs a repeatable basis. Cosine takes turns: one turn returns to the same reading, while quarter and half turns occupy different positions. The component computes values. First change the starting phase and inspect arrangement within one cycle. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 相位是所有位置共同的角度偏移；比较四分之一周和整整一周，不需要手算三角函数。
hint.en: Phase is a shared angular offset. Compare a quarter turn with a full turn; no trigonometric calculation is required.

brief.zh: 位置以整行长度为 1，频率是整行的周期数，相位以周计。造一个能够随频率和相位变化的单位幅度余弦波。
brief.en: Positions span one row length; frequency is cycles per row and phase is in turns. Build a unit-amplitude cosine wave that responds to frequency and phase.

t.zh: 单周期的相位变化已经验证。现在把整行的周期数也作为输入：它改变位置刻度走过的圈数，相位仍负责共同的角度偏移。用 0、1 和多个周期区分间距与起点。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Single-cycle phase shifts are verified. Now accept cycles per row as an input: it changes how many turns the position scale traverses, while phase remains a shared offset. Compare zero, one and multiple cycles to distinguish spacing from starting phase. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 频率改变单位长度内转过的周期数，不是把所有位置一起平移。相位才负责共同的角度偏移。
naiveWhy.en: Frequency changes cycles across the row; it is not a common position shift. Phase supplies the common angular offset.

hint.zh: 先固定相位比较不同周期数，再固定周期数比较不同相位。余弦元件自动完成三角函数计算。
hint.en: Hold phase fixed to compare cycle counts, then hold frequency fixed to compare phases. Cosine supplies the arithmetic.

desc.zh: 按位置、频率和相位输出单位幅度余弦波，角度以周计。
desc.en: Generate unit-amplitude cosine readings from positions, frequency and phase in turns.
